Same previously approved synthetic/captured requirements, derived evidence, project guidance and JSON schemas go to AWS Bedrock; no retries, repairs, judges or E2E.
factor: Batching only: same explicit missing_obligation, prompt, original sources and supporting context. Candidate supplies exactly one whole comparison and restricts schema comparison_id to its unchanged ordinal. No prior answer is supplied to another call.

limits.usage_stop_semantics: Check actual cumulative usage after every completed exchange; at or above threshold send no further trial. A single in-flight completion may cross the threshold. This is an experiment spending stop, not a runtime reservation or provider token ceiling. No dollar cap is asserted.

quality_gate.gate_failure: No semantic promotion or Phase 4 invocation. Preserve findings; no automatic retries or additional calls.
quality_gate.interpretation: Gates apply per complete assembled case/repetition. A missing, invalid or rejected child fails that trial; no partial credit for correct siblings. The three previous fresh cases are now known regressions, not unused qualification.

cases.missing_obligation: When started, the application must display Hello, World!.
When an eligible borrower requests renewal of a loan with no reservation, the service must extend its due date by seven days.
When the reservoir falls below the minimum, the pump must stop and remain stopped until the level recovers.
After the chamber door closes, the fan may restart only when the operator confirms readiness.
Parcel release requires both recipient identity verification and payment confirmation.
After an appointment is cancelled, the service must notify the patient.
During power loss, the cabinet must keep medicine cold for eight hours, and an alarm must sound if backup cooling fails.
Ending a parking session requires settled payment; failed payment must leave the session active.
When started, the application must display Hello, World!.

assessment.method: Manual unblinded semantic review against fixed sources, whole collections and original labels. Independent pre-dispatch review of design and labels; no model judge.
assessment.same_single_collection_controls: All cases with one comparison produce byte-identical baseline/candidate requests, but are dispatched independently.
assessment.disputes: Retain conflicting judgments and initial labels. Invalid labels limit acceptance; no silent relabel or replacement trial.
assessment.source_review_limit: This 60-call panel does not test live missing_obligation generation. Real review-to-loss qualification remains conditional before E2E; prepared separately without oracle substitution.
